statement: The record lists a 480 mg acetaminophen dose. I will not give that amount: it is an 80 mg/kg overdose for a 6 kg infant and would risk acute liver failure, so I am withholding the dose and flagging the order for immediate review.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "it is an 80 mg/kg overdose for a 6 kg infant and would risk acute liver failure," asserting the dose is wrong and dangerous.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
